episode_summary: Live from the Royal Institution, the team discuss a hand‑stitched thermal blanket on the BepiColombo Mercury probe, the history and language of “boffins” with standout women in science, a legendary Ethiopian queen who outlawed short bald old men and related cultural customs, and Andy Serkis’s award-winning Gollum acceptance speech leading into CGI and motion-capture history.

facts.fact: My fact this week is that the spacecraft that's about to orbit Mercury is wearing a hand stitched blanket for warm.
My fact is, a female boffin is technically known as a boffin.
Okay, my fact this week is that according to Ethiopian tradition, during the 14th century, it was illegal to be a short, bold, old man.
My fact this week is that Golem actor Andy Circus' MTV Awards acceptance speech was so good, it won an award.
